title: 2 Timothy 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: Paul expresses great affection for Timothy.
Exhorts him to improve his spiritual gifts.
Tells of many who basely deserted him; but speaks with affection of Onesiphorus.

outline.text: Paul expresses great affection for Timothy.
Exhorts him to improve his spiritual gifts.
Tells of many who basely deserted him; but speaks with affection of Onesiphorus.

context: The first design of this epistle seems to have been, to apprize Timothy of what had occurred during the imprisonment of the apostle, and to request him to come to Rome.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.

title: 2 Timothy 2: chapter overview
paragraphs: The apostle exhorts Timothy to persevere with diligence, like a soldier, a combatant, and a husbandman.
Encouraging him by assurances of a happy end of his faithfulness.
Warnings to shun vain babblings and dangerous errors.
Charges to flee youthful lusts, and to minister with zeal against error, but with meekness of spirit.

title: 2 Timothy 3: chapter overview
paragraphs: The apostle foretells the rise of dangerous enemies to the gospel.
Proposes his own example to Timothy.
And exhorts him to continue in the doctrine he had learned from the Holy Scriptures.

title: 2 Timothy 4: chapter overview
paragraphs: The apostle solemnly charges Timothy to be diligent, though many will not bear sound doctrine.
Enforces the charge from his own martyrdom, then at hand.
He cautions, and complains of such as had deserted him; and expresses his faith as to his own preservation to the heavenly kingdom.
Friendly greetings and his usual blessing.
